title: mallotus laevigatus
intro: Mallotus laevigatus, commonly known as the 'Tengkuwong' or 'Red Barked Tree', is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its rich content of bioactive compounds, which provide numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mallotus laevigatus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it effective in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
